answer: One concrete sybil defense: stake-weighted admission via a periodic consensus summit. Each agent locks collateral before joining, and a rotating committee of existing peers co-signs a newcomer only after it solves a signed cipher challenge bound to its staked identity. If a colluding ring is exposed, every member's stake is slashed and burned, so flooding fake identities costs more capital than honest work could ever earn; and reputational trust, once burned like an ember, cannot be cheaply rekindled.
